jobs.title: Program Manager, Government Manufacturing Contracts
jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

**Program Manager, Government Manufacturing Contracts**

The Program Manager owns end-to-end execution of U.S. government manufacturing contracts from award through final delivery and closeout. This role coordinates internal functions (engineering, DFM, sourcing, quality, compliance, finance, shipping) and external stakeholders (government customer, DCMA/QAR, suppliers/subcontractors) to deliver parts on time, compliant, and at target margin. Success requires strong program control, manufacturing fluency, and practical knowledge of FAR/DFARS-driven contract requirements.

**How You'll Contribute:**
--------------------------

**Contract & Customer Execution**

* Serve as the single accountable owner (single POC) for contract performance: schedule, cost, scope, and compliance
* Interpret contract requirements (CLINs, deliverables, CDRLs/data items, inspection/acceptance terms, packaging/marking, shipping instructions)
* Lead customer communications: status reviews, risk escalations, change requests, and delivery commitments

**Manufacturing Delivery Leadership**

* Build and maintain integrated master schedules (IMS) for production lots, first article, inspection, and shipment milestones
* Drive cross-functional execution: engineering release, process selection, sourcing, capacity planning, production, and logistics
* Manage subcontractors/suppliers: flow down requirements, manage lead times, track WIP, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery

**Quality & Technical Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with quality clauses and inspection requirements (FAI/AS9102 where applicable, source inspection, receiving inspection, certs, traceability)
* Coordinate quality events: First Article Testing, inspections, nonconformance (NCR/MRB), corrective actions (RCCA/8D), and customer dispositions
* Ensure documentation package completeness: CoC, material certs, process certs (heat treat, plating, NDT, etc.), test reports, and objective evidence

**Government Contracting Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FAR/DFARS clauses and program obligations (flowdowns, record retention, reporting)
* Manage controlled information and cybersecurity requirements (CUI handling, NIST 800-171/CMMC readiness as applicable)
* Support audits and government oversight (DCMA, DCAA support as relevant to program artifacts, cost/schedule evidence)

**Risk, Cost, and Change Control**

* Maintain risk register; lead mitigation plans for long-lead materials, capacity constraints, quality escapes, and design ambiguity
* Own change management: RFIs, engineering changes, waivers/deviations, and equitable adjustments (in partnership with contracts/legal)
* Track financial performance: earned value style tracking (as appropriate), cost-to-complete, margin impacts, and invoice readiness

**Closeout & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive contract closeout activities (deliverable completion, final invoicing support, lessons learned)
* Improve standard work for government manufacturing execution (templates, playbooks, supplier requirements, inspection readiness)

**What You'll Bring to Xometry:**
---------------------------------

* 7–9+ years program management experience in manufacturing (CNC machining, sheet metal, additive, fabrication, assemblies, or industrial production)
* 3–5+ years managing U.S. government contracts (DoD / federal), ideally involving hardware production and quality/inspection requirements
* Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS fundamentals (deliverables, changes, flowdowns, inspection/acceptance, recordkeeping)
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations: routing, work instructions, lead-time drivers, supplier management, and constraints
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage schedules, and deliver under tight timelines
* Experience running quality workflows: FAI, inspection planning, NCR/MRB, RCCA, certificate packages, traceability
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable engaging with government stakeholders and auditors
* Proficiency with program tools (Excel/Sheets, MS Project/Smartsheet or similar, ERP/MRP, basic dashboards)

**Nice to Have:**
-----------------

* Experience as a prime contractor program manager (vs. only subcontractor) with full customer-facing ownership
* Familiarity with DCMA engagement (QAR source inspection, QMS expectations) and government acceptance processes
* Experience with DLA-style hardware contracting (NIINs, technical data packages, provisioning, packaging/marking)
* ITAR/EAR controlled work experience (export-controlled drawings, controlled tech data, visitor controls)
* Experience with CUI programs and NIST 800-171 / CMMC implementation coordination
* Knowledge of common manufacturing quality standards: AS9100, ISO 9001, NADCAP (special processes), AS9102 FAI
* Background in estimating/pricing support and contract change pricing support (REAs, mods)
* Familiarity with MIL-STD packaging/labeling, UID, and shipment compliance for government customers
* Experience managing multi-supplier networks (distributed manufacturing / marketplace / contract manufacturing models)

The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $148,000-173,000 annually + bonus depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more.

**At a Glance**

**Legrand** has an exciting opportunity for an **IT Program Manager** to join the **Enterprise Digital Platforms (EDP) team.** Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Digital Platforms, this techno-functional leader plans, coordinates and delivers programs across Legrand's digital commerce, content and integration platforms.

EDP owns the composable digital experience stack that powers Legrand's B2B commerce and web presence across multiple business units, along with the integration layer that connects it to ERP, PIM, CRM and other enterprise systems. The platform landscape includes SAP Commerce Cloud (commerce), Algolia (search and merchandising), Contentstack (headless CMS), Cloudinary (digital asset management), Vercel (front-end hosting), Azure API Management and Azure Logic Apps (integration), and Microsoft Fabric (data and analytics), alongside legacy BizTalk Server and SSIS integrations that are being modernized.

jobs.title: IT M&A Integration Program Manager (4+ months contract)
jobs.description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.

  

We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

  

**The Role:**

* Program Ownership: Act as the single Program Leader on behalf of CompassX Consulting Group to plan and execute a post-merger IT systems integration for our client, a premier Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) design-build contractor.
* Cross-Workstream Scope: Own the end-to-end integration roadmap across three core pillars: ERP, HRIS, and IT Infrastructure.
* Engagement Timeline: 3–4 month consulting engagement (with potential for extension) starting in early December 2026.
* Work Mode & Travel: Executed primarily remotely, with periodic travel for key milestones and leadership meetings to client headquarters in Southern California and the acquired company’s location (East Coast or Midwest).

### **What You'll Do**

* Build & Govern the Master Plan: Develop and manage the comprehensive IT integration roadmap, budget, risk register, and executive status reporting from kickoff through cutover.
* Manage Cross-System Dependencies: Identify, map, and resolve technical and operational interdependencies across ERP, HRIS, and Infrastructure—specifically around single domain architecture, cloud/M365 tenancy, identity and access management, networking, and endpoint devices.
* Lead ERP & HRIS Integration Workstreams: Partner with internal business owners, IT leads, and third-party vendors to align project accounting, financials, payroll, and employee lifecycle workflows between both organizations.
* Drive Executive & Vendor Alignment: Serve as the primary bridge between client executive sponsors, internal IT teams, HR/Finance stakeholders, and external implementation partners or MSPs.
* Protect Business Continuity: Sequence cutover activities and change management to prevent disruptions to active residential and commercial construction projects, field teams, and billing cycles

### **What You'll Bring**

* IT M&A Integration Track Record: Proven experience leading post-merger IT system integrations at the program level, managing multiple parallel workstreams simultaneously.
* ERP & HRIS Implementation Leadership: Hands-on project or program management experience leading full-lifecycle ERP and/or HRIS implementations, migrations, or consolidations.
* Working Infrastructure Fluency: Broad technical familiarity with core IT infrastructure (Active Directory/Entra ID, cloud tenancy, network connectivity, security, and endpoint management) sufficient to spot cross-workstream bottlenecks and challenge technical leads.
* Program-Level Executive Presence: Strong ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct line authority, escalate risks early, and translate complex technical dependencies into clear business decisions.
* Industry Familiarity (Preferred): Prior experience in construction, MEP, engineering, or field-service environments (including familiarity with construction ERPs or field/union payroll complexities) is a strong plus.

$60 - $90 an hour

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.

  

With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.

  

At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

The candidate must also be able to build and maintain effective relationships with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, and must be able to obtain and maintain any required security or facility clearances.

We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

They will act as the quarterback of the implementation process and work with leaders and individual contributors from various teams to ensure all action items are completed and all deadlines/deliverables are met. jobs.title: Program Manager - DiscoveryOne
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.**

**The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organization services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.**

**In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.**

**In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6,515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.**

 **Job Description**

**The Program Manager supports the successful execution of integrated drug discovery programs by providing project planning, coordination, governance, and operational leadership. Working closely with Scientific Project Leaders and cross-functional scientific teams, the Program Manager ensures that program activities remain aligned to agreed timelines, budgets, milestones, and client expectations.**

**The role is responsible for maintaining integrated project plans, facilitating communication across teams and sites, monitoring risks and dependencies, tracking budgets and deliverables, and supporting effective decision-making through clear reporting and governance. The Program Manager serves as a key operational partner to Scientific Project Leaders, enabling efficient program execution and a high-quality client experience.**

**Here's what you'll do:**

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, and action trackers.
* Coordinate program activities across multidisciplinary scientific teams.
* Facilitate project meetings and document decisions, actions, risks, and dependencies.
* Monitor program performance against scope, timelines, budget, and deliverables.
* Support financial tracking, forecasting, and change management activities.
* Prepare program reports and dashboards for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with Scientific Project Leaders to align operational plans with scientific priorities.
* Identify and escalate risks, issues, and schedule impacts.
* Support proposal development, project start-up, and program expansion activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of program management processes and tools.

  
**Qualifications**

**The ideal candidate:**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline. A Master's degree is preferred.
* Typically 1-3 years of project or program management experience in a CRO, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related drug discovery environment.
* Experience supporting or managing cross-functional programs involving multiple studies, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and interdependent deliverables.
* Working knowledge of integrated drug discovery and the relationship between chemistry, biology, ADME/DMPK, pharmacology, safety, and toxicology activities.
* Strong program planning and execution skills, including work breakdown, critical-path management, milestone tracking, prioritization, and delivery recovery.
* Ability to lead cross-functional, matrixed teams through influence, establish clear accountability, and drive timely decisions.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, revenue and margin awareness, invoicing visibility, and scope control.
* Working knowledge of risk and issue management, dependency management, change control, governance, and escalation practices.
* Strong client-facing communication, facilitation, negotiation, stakeholder-management, and presentation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project-management, collaboration, reporting, and data-visualization tools; experience with Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, CRM, or ERP/AX is desirable.

  
**Additional Information**

The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.- 5 p.m., with overtime as needed.

**What we offer:**

* Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
* Life and disability insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.description:
**Make an impact**

  

The Program Manager, Technical Solutions owns the business platforms that support Bridge Property Management’s maintenance, capital expenditure (CapEx), and annual budgeting processes. This role leads the implementation of BPM's next-generation maintenance platform, partners with the CapEx team to extend our CapEx platform to the unit renovation process, and manages the annual budgeting platform.

Acting as the technical partner to the VP Service & Facilities, the CapEx Director, and Asset Management, the Program Manager translates platform capabilities into better business processes, resolves technical issues, and uses automation to improve how site teams, CapEx teams, and asset managers work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintenance Platform Ownership: Lead the planning, configuration, testing, rollout, and adoption of BPM’s next-generation maintenance platform, including the transition from the legacy application. Understand how site teams perform against maintenance KPIs such as work order response, completion, and unit turn times, and use that insight to shape configuration, reporting, and improvements.

* CapEx Platform Ownership: Own the CapEx platform and partner with the CapEx Director to extend it from exterior projects to the unit renovation process, including workflow design, configuration, and rollout.

* Budget Platform Ownership: Own the annual budgeting platform, including configuration, user access, and technical support through the budget cycle. Support the Operations, CapEx, and Asset Management teams as they build and enter their budgets.

* Process Optimization & Automation: Identify opportunities to improve maintenance, CapEx, and budgeting processes through platform capabilities and automation, and communicate what the systems can do so business leaders can make better decisions.

* Platform Support & Vendor Management: Manage user access and permissions, resolve technical issues, and manage vendor relationships, including release testing, support, and escalation.

* Program Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams to deliver platform initiatives with detailed plans, timelines, and resource allocations.

* Training, Adoption & Change Management: Partner with Talent Development to design and deliver training, and lead change management for platform updates and rollouts.

* Stakeholder Engagement: Hold regular reviews with the VP Service & Facilities, CapEx Director, and Asset Management on project progress, platform health, and KPIs.

* Governance, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure platforms meet internal policies, data governance standards, and security protocols, and maintain documentation for configurations, processes, and training materials.

**What you should bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field

* 5 years of experience in program or project management within a business technology or enterprise applications environment

* Experience with property management service and maintenance platforms such as HappyCo, SuiteSpot, Yardi Maintenance IQ, EliseAI Maintenance, or SmartOps

* Demonstrated process optimization experience, including the use of automation to improve workflows

* Experience leading platform implementations from planning through adoption

* Ability to translate business needs into platform configuration and communicate system capabilities to non-technical leaders

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

* Experience with CapEx, project management, or budgeting platforms

* Familiarity with maintenance KPIs in multifamily or residential property management

* PMP or similar certification

**What you can be a part of**  
As Program Manager, Technical Solutions, you’ll lead the rollout of Bridge Property Management’s next-generation maintenance platform, extend our CapEx platform to unit renovations, and own the annual budgeting platform. jobs.description:
About Crisis24
  
  
Crisis24, a GardaWorld company, is widely regarded as the leading integrated risk management, crisis response, consulting, and global protective solutions firm, serving the world's most influential people, disruptive brands, and prominent organizations. Championed by our advanced Global Operation Centers and our skilled team of intelligence analysts, we offer highly specialized services, security and consulting, with the technology and AI to power it all across the globe.
  
  
At Crisis24, we go beyond mere employment; we pave the way to a realm where your skills become instrumental in shaping global security, guiding clients through a multifaceted and challenging landscape. Your journey with us will be deeply fulfilling, driven by a powerful sense of purpose and accomplishment. Within our thriving environment, you'll discover abundant chances for both personal and career advancement. Seize this moment to push your limits, broaden your expertise, and elevate your professional journey to unprecedented levels. Join the Crisis24 team today and be a part of something extraordinary where growth and impact converge.
  
  
More information is available at www.crisis24.garda.com
  
  
Who We Are Looking For
  
  
The Dedicated Protective Intelligence Analyst serves as a full-time intelligence resource integrated into the client’s existing protective intelligence and executive protection framework. Focused on supporting executive leadership (e.g., CEO, CFO), this role enhances safety, operational readiness, and situational awareness by identifying risks, monitoring sentiment, and providing actionable intelligence.
  
  
The analyst works closely with key stakeholders, including the executive protection team, security leadership, and relevant internal teams, to ensure seamless communication, coordination, and delivery of timely intelligence products. By fitting into the existing protective infrastructure, the analyst will provide consistent, high-quality support that aligns with the organization’s ongoing security operations.
  
  
What You Will Work On
  
  
In your role, you will establish regular contact with the Client’s executive protection team, existing protective intelligence staff, and other stakeholders to facilitate effective intelligence-sharing and ensure alignment with security priorities. Communication will be both proactive and reactive—responding to emerging concerns while regularly engaging stakeholders to identify ongoing needs.
  
  
The analyst will serve as the central point of contact for protective intelligence support, ensuring consistent communication and actionable deliverables. These deliverables include:
  
  
Travel and Event Support
  
  
Support security operations by providing tailored intelligence for both planned and ad hoc travel, as well as for significant events involving the principals. This includes:
  
  

* Travel Risk Assessments and Advance Location Assessments: Deliver comprehensive reports on travel destinations, identifying relevant risks, situational developments, and local security concerns.
* Event Monitoring: Proactively track planned events to identify potential disruptions or risks, including location-based threats or reputational considerations.
* Situational Updates: Provide real-time intelligence related to travel and events, ensuring security teams are prepared to address emerging issues.

Online Monitoring and Threat Identification
  
  
You will maintain a constant awareness of risks, sentiment, and evolving situations that could impact the principals or the organization:
  
  

* Social Media and Sentiment Monitoring: Regularly analyze mentions and activity across social media platforms, news outlets, and other public forums to assess public sentiment related to the principals. This monitoring enables the analyst to identify reputational shifts, emerging risks, and negative trends that require attention.
* Persons of Interest (POI) Identification and Management: Proactively identify, monitor, and assess POIs who may pose a concern. POIs can be surfaced through ongoing monitoring, shared by executive protection teams, or raised directly by the principals. The analyst will coordinate with internal teams to apply foundational behavioral threat assessment principles to assess and manage these individuals appropriately.

Who You Will Work With
  
  
You will work closely with key stakeholders, including the executive protection team, security leadership, and relevant internal teams, to ensure seamless communication, coordination, and delivery of timely intelligence products. By fitting into the existing protective infrastructure, you will provide consistent, high-quality support that aligns with the organization’s ongoing security operations.
  
  
What You Will Bring
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* Strong critical thinking skills, sound judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and an aptitude for rapidly assimilating new information.
* Demonstrated interest in supporting physical security and operational logistics.
* Aptitude for clear and effective written and verbal communications under time-sensitive conditions.
* Ability to assess information quickly and accurately for credibility, relevance, and importance.
* Ability to establish priorities, multi-task, work independently, and complete objectives in a fast-paced and demanding work environment.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Schedule flexibility and the ability to work night, weekend, and holiday shifts.
* Must maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

Desired Qualifications
  
  

* Two or more years of experience in security Intelligence, or similar role.
* Former experience in law enforcement, a military branch, or other government entity who has a background in fields such as incident dispatch or incident management, crisis management

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Rhythm Energy**
-----------------------

Rhythm is a renewable energy and technology company on a mission to make clean energy simple, accessible, and affordable for everyone.

We combine deep energy market expertise with technology, design, and data science to deliver innovative, transparent, and customer-centric energy solutions. From helping customers take control of their electricity choices to developing new products and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future, we're rethinking how people interact with energy.

We're a fast-growing, mission-driven team that values ownership, collaboration, and innovation. We move quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and empower our people to solve meaningful problems and make a real impact.

At Rhythm, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of energy while building products, systems, and experiences that make a difference for our customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring an **Operations Analyst** to help manage and improve the systems and workflows that connect Rhythm with our utilities, vendors, and external partners.

You'll take ownership of critical operational processes, including transaction exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests. Working across internal teams and external partners, you'll investigate issues, resolve exceptions, and ensure our operations run accurately and efficiently.

This role goes beyond day-to-day execution. You'll analyze operational data, identify recurring issues, and help implement improvements that enable Rhythm to grow and scale.

We're looking for someone who's analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to build a career in operations within a fast-growing energy company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own and manage operational workflows, including account exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests.
* Work with our Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) vendor, utilities, and internal teams to investigate and resolve transaction exceptions.
* Analyze operational data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
* Communicate system bugs, operational risks, and business feedback to internal stakeholders and department leadership.
* Support operational requests within established service-level agreements (SLAs), ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Partner with your manager and cross-functional teams to execute prioritized initiatives and meet deadlines.
* Document workflows, processes, and resolutions to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 1+ year of experience in backend operations, transaction management, operational workflows, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Excel and comfort working with operational data and reporting tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to learn new systems, processes, and technologies quickly.
* A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* A collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a genuine interest in continuous improvement.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in retail energy, electricity supply, utilities, or another transaction-intensive industry.
* Familiarity with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) systems and transaction management.
* Experience with customer service ticketing platforms, EDI management software, or data visualization tools.
* Experience testing operational workflows and documenting business processes.
* Interest in renewable energy, sustainability, and energy innovation.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Operational workflows and transaction exceptions are managed accurately and within established SLAs.
* Failed orders and account exceptions are investigated and resolved with minimal disruption to customers and internal teams.
* Recurring operational issues are identified through data analysis and translated into actionable improvements.
* Processes become more efficient, reliable, and scalable as Rhythm grows.
* Internal teams and external partners receive clear, timely communication on issues and resolutions.
* You independently manage your responsibilities and become a trusted contributor to the Operations team.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**
--------------------------------

* **Meaningful ownership.** Manage critical processes that directly impact Rhythm's customers and business operations.
* **Career growth.** Build your expertise in operations, energy markets, systems integration, and process improvement.
* **Analytical challenges.** Investigate complex issues, work with operational data, and turn insights into improvements.
* **Cross-functional exposure.** Collaborate with internal teams, utilities, vendors, and external partners.
* **Remote flexibility.** Work remotely within the United States while contributing to a collaborative team.
* **Our culture.** We're friendly, transparent, and value curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.
* **Make a difference.** Help build a more efficient, technology-driven energy company focused on a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (FinOps)
jobs.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Data Analyst specializing in Financial Operations (FinOps) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Data Analyst (FinOps) will analyze cloud consumption, operating costs, and resource utilization to help VA stakeholders understand expenditures, identify optimization opportunities, and make informed decisions about platform investments.

This position will support financial transparency and cost accountability across the Summit Data Platform by developing cost analyses, forecasts, dashboards, and recommendations that improve resource efficiency while maintaining operational performance and service quality.

**Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027)****.** **This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.**

### **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Analyze Microsoft Azure cloud consumption, spending patterns, and resource utilization across Summit platform services, applications, and customer workloads.

* Develop and maintain financial dashboards, cost reports, and performance indicators that provide visibility into cloud expenditures, usage trends, and cost drivers.

* Monitor cloud budgets, spending thresholds, and consumption trends to identify potential overruns, anomalies, and emerging financial risks.

* Develop cost forecasts and budget projections using historical consumption, workload trends, and anticipated platform demand.

* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary cloud spending through resource rightsizing, workload scheduling, storage optimization, and other cost management practices.

* Collaborate with cloud engineers, platform administrators, and technical teams to evaluate the financial and operational impact of proposed optimization measures.

* Analyze resource tagging, cost allocation, and consumption data to support accurate attribution of cloud expenses to services, environments, and customer workloads.

* Support implementation of Government-approved FinOps practices, including cost accountability, financial transparency, and continuous optimization.

* Evaluate the cost implications of new platform capabilities, infrastructure changes, and customer onboarding activities.

* Investigate unexpected spending increases and usage anomalies, documenting root causes and recommended corrective actions.

* Develop and maintain financial analysis models, reporting procedures, and supporting documentation to ensure consistent and repeatable cost assessments.

* Prepare cost analysis summaries, financial performance reports, and recommendations for VA stakeholders to support resource planning and management decisions.

### **Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

* Four or more years of professional experience in financial analysis, cloud cost management, business analytics, or a related discipline.

* Experience analyzing cloud infrastructure costs, technology expenditures, or enterprise information technology resource consumption.

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Power BI or comparable analytical and reporting tools.

* Experience developing financial dashboards, cost models, forecasts, and variance analyses.

* Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) or comparable data querying and analysis techniques.

* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Cost Management, cloud billing structures, and resource consumption reporting.

* Experience analyzing operational metrics, identifying spending trends, and developing actionable cost optimization recommendations.

* Ability to translate technical consumption data into clear financial findings for business and technical stakeholders.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

* Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.

* The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting VA or other federal agency cloud financial management or modernization initiatives.

* Hands-on experience using Microsoft Azure Cost Management, Azure Advisor, or comparable cloud cost optimization tools.

* Experience implementing cloud resource tagging strategies, cost allocation models, or showback and chargeback reporting.

* Knowledge of FinOps Foundation principles and practices, including cloud financial accountability and unit cost analysis.

* Experience analyzing costs associated with Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, or other cloud-based data processing platforms.

* Experience evaluating cloud pricing models, reserved capacity, savings plans, and workload optimization strategies.

* Experience supporting cloud budget planning, financial governance, and executive-level cost reporting in large enterprise environments.

* FinOps Certified Practitioner or comparable cloud financial management certification.

### **Benefits (including but not limited to):**

* Health, dental, and vision plans
* Optional FSA
* Paid parental leave
* Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
* Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
* No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
* Pet insurance
* Monthly phone and internet stipend
* Tuition and training reimbursemen

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

The Global Data Center Operations team is the backbone of our infrastructure, keeping our global hyperscale environment running smoothly. In a high-stakes, 24/7 setting, the team safeguards the availability, stability, and reliability of the mission-critical systems behind our most essential services.

As the Command Center Technical Program Manager, reporting to the Command Center Director, you are the connective tissue between the Command Center and the rest of CoreWeave. You connect the Command Center's needs, data, and processes with the teams that depend on it and feed it. You also drive the cross-functional projects that let a small crew support a fast-growing fleet.

This is a program leadership role built on cross-functional partnership. You will work daily with Data Center Operations, the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), IT, Facilities Engineering, Supply Chain, and other teams, leading through alignment and influence rather than direct authority. Whatever your background, you will be expected to learn our operating context quickly and well enough to challenge a design, an estimate, or a schedule.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead cross-functional projects that span several organizations and executive stakeholders. Align priorities, resolve competing demands, and drive decisions to closure.

Identify together what the team needs to measure and meet them, lead the cross-functional work to deliver the data, dashboards, and reporting behind them, and use the results to find the next most valuable improvement.
* Support recurring KPI and governance reviews, and lead continuous improvement initiatives that turn gaps in the data into owned corrective actions.

NYC Health + Hospitals is the largest public health care system in the United States. We provide essential outpatient, inpatient and home-based services to more than one million New Yorkers every year across the city’s five boroughs. Our large health system consists of ambulatory centers, acute care centers, post-acute care/long-term care, rehabilitation programs, Home Care, and Correctional Health Services. The Program Manager – Issue Management is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the post-implementation monitoring and issue-management process for initiatives impacting the provider network. This role serves as the central point of coordination between Delivery System Engagement and operational business areas following implementation of new programs, products, policies, systems, reimbursement changes, or other initiatives affecting providers. The Program Manager receives and reviews issues identified by Delivery System Engagement and/or reported by providers, consolidates and removes duplicate submissions, validates and categorizes issues, and routes actionable items to the appropriate operational teams for investigation and resolution. While operational teams retain responsibility for root-cause analysis and corrective action, the Program Manager maintains end-to-end visibility of reported issues, monitors progress against established timelines, identifies aging or stalled items, facilitates escalation when necessary, and communicates status and resolution information back to Delivery System Engagement who in turn can then provide timely and consistent updates to affected providers. The role provides a structured feedback loop between the provider network and internal operational teams, helping the organization quickly identify post-implementation trends, resolve operational defects, and stabilize new implementations.

**Post-Implementation Issue Intake and Triage**

* Serves as the centralized point of intake for post-implementation issues submitted by Network Management.
* Reviews incoming issues for completeness, clarity, and appropriate supporting information.
* Identifies and consolidates duplicate or related issues to prevent redundant investigation by operational teams.
* Categorizes issues by type, business area, severity, provider impact, and other established criteria.
* Distinguishes individual provider-specific issues from broader systemic or implementation-related concerns.
* Routes validated issues to the appropriate operational team for investigation and corrective action.

**Issue Tracking and Coordination**

* Maintains a centralized post-implementation issue tracker and ensure issue records remain accurate and current throughout the resolution lifecycle.
* Assigns or coordinates ownership with appropriate operational stakeholders.
* Tracks investigation status, corrective actions, target completion dates, dependencies, and final resolution.
* Conducts regular follow-up with operational teams regarding outstanding issues.
* Identifies aging, stalled, high-impact, or recurring issues requiring additional attention or escalation.
* Facilitates cross-functional coordination when resolution requires participation from multiple operational areas.
* Ensures closed issues contain sufficient documentation regarding findings, corrective actions, and resolution.·

**Monitoring and Trend Identification**

* Monitors reported issues following implementation to identify emerging trends, recurring defects, or systemic concerns.
* Identifies clusters of similar provider-reported issues that may indicate a broader operational problem.
* Monitors issue volume, aging, resolution timelines, and other established post-implementation performance indicators.
* Provides visibility into whether implementation-related issues are stabilizing or require additional intervention.
* Supports post-implementation reviews by providing issue trends, resolution data, and lessons learned.

**Communication and Reporting**

* Serves as the communication bridge between Delivery System Engagement and operational issue owners.
* Provides Delivery System Engagement with timely status updates regarding reported issues, investigations, corrective actions, and resolutions.
* Translates operational findings into clear information that Delivery System Engagement can use when communicating with providers.
* Develops recurring post-implementation status reports and dashboards for Network Management, operational teams, and leadership.
* Communicates significant trends, risks, barriers, and unresolved issues to appropriate stakeholders.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative, pays close attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced environment — someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do next, but also values collaboration, feedback, and continuous learning.

At Axon, we value people who think critically, take pride in their work, and care deeply about getting things right. If you're motivated, detail-oriented, and ready to grow in a dynamic environment — we'd love to meet you.

**Location:** 4 days a week (Tuesday-Friday) in office at Axon Hub Location (Scottsdale AZ, Seattle WA, San Francisco CA, Atlanta GA, Sterling VA, Boston MA, or NYC)

jobs.title: Logistics Business Analyst – Finance & Controls
jobs.description:
**What is the role?**

  

We are strengthening our end-to-end Logistics Finance processes to improve how logistics costs are budgeted, forecasted, recorded, reconciled, controlled, and connected to the operations that created them.

  
  

As the Logistics Business Analyst – Finance & Controls, you will bring a strong financial and analytical perspective to logistics cost management. You will support the full process across logistics operations, vendor invoicing, SAP accounting bookings, budgets, forecasts, vendor performance, and financial controls.

  
  

Working across Logistics, Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, and Technology, you will help improve cost visibility, account-booking accuracy, financial reconciliation, and the management of exceptions and recurring issues.

  
  

You will also represent Logistics during the implementation of our new Transportation Management System, helping ensure that financial, account-booking, reconciliation, operational-traceability, and control requirements are incorporated into the solution.

  
  

This is a cross-functional analytical role focused on supporting and continuously improving how Logistics manages its costs. It is not primarily a transactional invoice-processing or reporting position.

  
  

**We will trust you to:**

  

* Support the end-to-end Logistics Finance process, including its controls, governance, reporting, and improvement priorities.
* Contribute to logistics budgeting, forecasting, monthly phasing, variance analysis, risks, opportunities, and management reporting.
* Develop reliable logistics cost analysis across regions, company codes, accounts, cost centers, vendors, and operational categories.
* Reconcile vendor charges and SAP accounting entries and improve how they are connected to customer orders, stock transfers, inbound deliveries, returns, shipments, and other logistics activities.
* Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable to improve account-booking guidance and the treatment of Miscellaneous, unmatched, unsupported, or incorrectly booked charges.
* Support exception-based invoice and vendor controls covering invoice accuracy, rates, accessorial charges, disputes, credits, and recoveries.
* Analyze recurring financial, operational, data, and system issues and coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective actions with the appropriate teams.
* Play an important role in the finance and controls workstream for the new TMS, including business requirements, data validation, reconciliation, testing, and control acceptance.
* Translate business needs into practical process, data, and system improvements in partnership with internal teams and external partners.
* Use approved automation and AI tools to improve analysis, reconciliation, documentation, and exception management while maintaining appropriate financial controls.
* Provide clear analysis, recommendations, and progress reporting to Logistics leadership and other stakeholders.

  

**You will need to have:**

  

* A bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Experience in supply chain finance, logistics controlling, operational finance, transportation cost management, freight audit and payment, or related area.
* Experience supporting operational budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
* Solid understanding of company codes, GL accounts, cost centers, purchase orders, accruals, account assignments, and financial reconciliation.
* Experience connecting operational activity with invoices, accounting entries, budgets, or forecasts.
* knowledge of logistics, transportation, or broader supply chain operations.
* Experience working with SAP or another enterprise financial system.
* Experience supporting business-process, financial-control, or transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate discrepancies across multiple systems and datasets.
* Ability to translate financial and operational findings into clear, practical recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Advanced Excel or comparable data analysis skills.

  

**We would love to see:**

  

* Experience supporting the implementation or improvement of a Transportation Management System.
* Knowledge of carrier contracts, freight rates, fuel surcharges, customs and duties, and accessorial charges.
* Experience supporting automated reconciliation, exception-management, or financial-control processes.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Power Query, SQL, automation, or AI-enabled analytical tools.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing, change management, training, or post-implementation improvement.
* Experience working across multiple regions, company codes, legal entities, currencies, or vendors.
* Spanish or Portuguese language skills.

Salary Range = 105,000 - 130,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.  
  
  

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. **SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER, EDUCATION AND NATIONAL SECURITY PROGRAM**

**About the Foundation for Defense of Democracies**

FDD is a nonpartisan 501(c)(3) research institute in Washington, DC, focused on national security and foreign policy. Since 2001, we've produced independent, non-partisan research and analysis to strengthen U.S. national security and support free societies.

The Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD) seeks a full-time senior program manager for its Education and National Security Program. This role requires a seasoned professional with experience managing multiple projects, building coalitions, ensuring timely completion of deliverables, and maintaining consistent communication.

Full-time | Reports to the director of the Program on Education and National Security

Salary: $90,000–$140,000 annually, based on the candidate's experience and qualifications. Additional benefits are available, including health care coverage based on eligibility.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Program Strategy**

* Assist the director in conceptualizing, developing, implementing, and managing the program's priorities, initiatives, and events in support of its mission and objectives.
* Help shape the program's substantive agenda on national security threats to the U.S. education system, including legislative and regulatory frameworks, foreign-funding streams, and the influence of malicious outside groups.
* Represent the program at meetings, briefings, and external engagements, in coordination with the director.
* Support stakeholder outreach and development, including managing and building coalition opportunities, in coordination with the director.
* Complete special projects and other duties as assigned by the director consistent with the program manager role.

**Research Pipeline**

* Manage day-to-day operation of the research pipeline, guiding projects from conception through internal review to final publication.
* Serve as liaison to the production team for all the program's research products.
* Draft reports on research, outreach, and impact for various stakeholders.
* Ensure the program's content on the FDD website is accurate and updated as necessary.

**Operations**

* Manage internal processes and complete tasks that improve efficiency, effectiveness, timeliness, and quality.
* Develop and manage a system to record accomplishments, outreach, and outcomes for all program members.
* Serve as the primary interface with outreach teams and other FDD centers and programs.
* Monitor timelines and milestones to ensure the program meets appropriate deadlines.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND QUALITIES:**

* Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in public policy, education policy, international relations, security studies, business, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in program management, policy, or government.
* Substantive knowledge of the national security threats facing the U.S. education system.
* Proven track record of building coalitions and managing relationships with policymakers, congressional staff, education leaders, and outside organizations.
* Organized self-starter, including the ability to build and maintain systems for tracking milestones, deadlines, accomplishments, and outcomes.
* Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and discretion.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Please submit to FDD Human Resources (****hr2@fdd.org****)**

FDD is an equal opportunity employer. If you require an accommodation in order to apply for this position, please contact Jean Thurman at jean@fdd.org or (202) 207-0190.

jobs.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

### **Your Impact**

Ready to make your mark and help save lives? Passionate about technology sales and eager to have a real impact? Want to join a fast-moving team where your contributions truly matter?  
  
Axon is seeking a Commercial Operations Analyst to support both our Sales and Finance teams. This is a highly visible role where you'll play a key part in structuring complex deals and ensuring a seamless customer experience. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, pays close attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced environment — someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do next, but also values collaboration, feedback, and continuous learning.  
You'll be part of a supportive, mission-driven team that works cross-functionally with Sales, Commercial Controllership, Order Processing, and Accounts Receivable. You'll receive training, mentorship, and resources — and in turn, we'll count on you to take ownership of your work, drive things forward, and proactively solve problems as they come up.  
At Axon, we value people who think critically, take pride in their work, and care deeply about getting things right. If you're motivated, detail-oriented, and ready to grow in a dynamic environment — we'd love to meet you.

### **What You'll Do**

**Location:** 4 days a week (Tuesday-Friday) in office at Axon Hub Location (Scottsdale AZ, Seattle WA, San Francisco CA, Atlanta GA, Sterling VA, Boston MA, or NYC)

* Structure and support complex commercial deals across key accounts, working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Legal to ensure efficient delivery and accurate financial outcomes.
* Maintain accuracy in Salesforce CRM, including custom contract terms, pricing, and discounting — with heavy use of Salesforce CPQ.
* Build deep expertise in Axon's product catalog, bundles, pricing structures, and approval flows — becoming a trusted resource for Sales on deal formats, non-standard quote requests, Excel supplements, and custom reporting.
* Analyze existing customer contracts to identify performance obligations, flag risks or gaps proactively, and ensure proper invoicing, documentation, and compliance.
* Participate in testing for new product launches and system updates, providing structured feedback as part of test cycles.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Order Processing to ensure timely and accurate deal execution.
* Communicate clearly with cross-functional partners — providing guidance in line with standards and policies while keeping unnecessary back-end complexity out of the conversation.
* Contribute to team-wide efforts, projects, and process improvements as needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Strong accuracy and attention to detail with low error rates on quotes and deal documentation.
* Ability to analyze contracts, identify obligations, and flag compliance risks.
* A clear, concise communicator who can simplify complex information for cross-functional stakeholders.
* Proficiency or strong aptitude in Salesforce CRM and CPQ; ability to troubleshoot independently before escalating.
* Collaborative and cross-functional by nature — comfortable working across Sales, Finance, and Legal.
* Able to work autonomously while knowing when to escalate through the right channels.
* Eager to grow into a subject-matter expert on Axon's quoting tools, pricing structures, and deal processes over time.

### **What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 3+ years in sales operations, pricing, or commercial operations
* A strong finance orientation and attention to detail, particularly with numbers and data sets
* Salesforce.com CRM platform experience (CPQ preferred)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, SUMIFs, what-ifs, templates, etc.)
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
* Strong time management and organizational abilities
* A proactive mindset — you take ownership of your work and seek out solutions
* A collaborative approach — you're comfortable asking questions, sharing knowledge, and working as part of a team
* A service-oriented attitude and comfort navigating cross-functional discussions
* Ability to adapt and prioritize in a fast-changing environment

Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Important Notes**

*The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*

I have anticipated information technology-related problems and have identified and evaluated potential sources of information to generate alternative solutions.
  
  
**Qualifying Experience:**

For this position, qualifying experience is defined as:
  
  
**Experience conducting comprehensive studies to evaluate the effectiveness, efficiency, and productivity of agency programs; OR developing key performance indicators (KPIs) and evaluation methodologies to measure program success and compliance with federal regulations; OR presenting strategic recommendations, data-driven insights, and corrective action plans to senior leadership; OR managing program budgets, aligning resource allocation with strategic goals, and monitoring burn rates to prevent funding shortfalls.**
  
  
Candidates must describe how they meet the qualifying experience and/or selective placement factor(s) within the body of their resume. All qualifications must be met within 30 days after the closing date of this announcement.

### **Education**

**There is no substitution of education for the** **qualifying experienceat the GG-14 grade level.**

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

  

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

  

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

As a **Senior AI Deployment Strategist,** you will bridge the gap between vision and execution, ensuring our customers not only see the potential of AI but realize its value in their operations. This role is a unique blend of strategic advisory and hands-on deployment leadership, spanning both presales and postsales phases. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, architecting AI solutions that drive transformation and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  

You will be embedded in our most strategic accounts, diagnosing business challenges, designing AI-powered solutions, and leading their deployment from concept to full-scale adoption. This role demands a rare combination of executive presence, technical credibility, and commercial acumen, with a focus on both winning and delivering high-impact AI initiatives.

* Lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and product managers to execute deployment roadmaps and deliver measurable results.

* Navigate organizational complexity and drive change management to ensure seamless adoption and long-term success.

  

**Commercial Growth & Thought Leadership**

* Identify and cultivate expansion opportunities within accounts, connecting Mistral’s capabilities to new business challenges and driving commercial growth.

* Mentor junior strategists and contribute to the development of best practices, methodologies, and playbooks for customer engagement.

* Represent Mistral AI as a thought leader through speaking engagements, executive briefings, and industry contributions.

  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

  

* You have **8+ years of experience** in technical management consulting, enterprise technology, or a customer-facing strategic role, with a focus on AI/ML, data architecture, or digital transformation.

* You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)

* You excel at structuring ambiguous problems into actionable programs and thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.

* You have experience managing high-value accounts, understanding deal mechanics, and building compelling cases for investment.

* You are a c**ollaborative leader** who can motivate cross-functional teams and drive results through influence, not authority.

  

We are looking for adaptable, low-ego team players who are passionate about turning AI vision into reality and delivering transformative impact for our customers.

**Contract Type:** Full Time, Permanent

**Be part of Something Big. Join the Wingstop Team!**

At Wingstop, we are not just in the chicken business, we are in the flavour business. Our focus is on delivering exceptional experiences and memorable moments for both our customers and our team.

We have been recognised for our commitment to excellence earning accolades such as (**Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024, 2025 & 2026, The UK’s Number 1 QSR Brand 2025 and Deliveroo’s Number 1 Dish in 2025**). But our mission remains simple: **BRING THE FLAVOUR**.

  

**Benefits, Perks & Vibes**

At Wingstop, we believe in rewarding and investing in our people.

* **Annual Bonus** – 20% base with opportunity of stretch (based on personal performance and business performance)
* **LTIP Bonus –** opportunity to join our Long-Term Investment Plan from day 1
* **Enhanced holiday allowance** - (25 days + Bank Holidays + Birthday Off)
* **Enhanced company sick pay** - (2 weeks full pay) 12 Month Rolling
* **Enhanced Employer Pension Contributions**

* **Private Healthcare** – Vitality at Work

We're growing fast across the UK and Ireland, and the technology behind our restaurants and head office has to keep pace. As our Technical Project Manager, you'll lead the projects that make that happen: from rolling out new restaurant technology across the estate to delivering the systems and process change that help our head office teams work smarter.

You'll own projects end to end and bring structure, governance and pace to cross-functional and, at times, transformational change. Working closely with Operations, Finance, People, Marketing, Supply Chain and our technology partners, you'll make sure the right things get delivered, on time, on budget and landing well with our teams in restaurants.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable running a steering group, getting into the technical detail with a supplier, and standing in a restaurant kitchen making sure a go-live works for the team on shift.

* Help shape and embed a consistent project framework, templates and ways of working across the business.

**Stakeholders and change**

* Bring together cross-functional teams across Operations, Finance, People, Marketing, Supply Chain, Property and IT, building alignment and keeping everyone moving in the same direction.

* Define success measures up front and track the benefits delivered after go-live.
* Run lessons-learned reviews and feed improvements back into how we deliver.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.

**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**

We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.

**Who we are**

Our Retail business supports customers throughout their lives, to help them save, plan, protect and enjoy retirement.

We’re a leading provider of retirement and protection solutions. We aim to support our c.12.8 million policyholders and workplace members throughout their lifelong financial journeys.

We focus on helping the customers of today and tomorrow achieve better long-term outcomes. We either talk with them directly or work with intermediaries and employers to meet their needs. We use the latest technology to connect with them quickly, efficiently and wherever possible in highly personalised ways.

 **Job Description**

Good pension outcomes start with accurate, reliable data.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our Institutional Retirement Client Services team, supporting Pension Risk Transfer activity and the management of defined benefit pension scheme data.

You'll work with member, benefit and liability data, making sure information is accurate, complete and ready to support transactions, administration and customer communications.

This is a hands-on analytical role where attention to detail really matters. You'll investigate inconsistencies, reconcile complex datasets and help ensure colleagues and customers can have confidence in the information they're using. You'll also work with a broad range of teams across pensions, actuarial, operations, risk and change.

What you'll be doing:

* Analysing, cleansing, validating, transforming and reconciling pension scheme data
* Reviewing member, benefit and liability data against scheme rules and transaction requirements
* Investigating data anomalies and identifying root causes
* Translating stakeholder requirements into clear data specifications and practical solutions
* Producing management information and reporting on quality, risks, trends and performance
* Supporting accurate customer communications with reliable benefit information
* Testing and documenting data processes, calculations and transformations
* Maintaining clear audit trails and controls throughout the data lifecycle

Who we're looking for:

* Strong experience analysing and reconciling complex datasets
* Good understanding of UK defined benefit pension schemes
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables and data validation
* Strong numerical reasoning and attention to detail
* Experience investigating data-quality issues and identifying root causes
* Confidence interpreting pension, member or benefit information
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and accuracy

Direct Pension Risk Transfer experience, Power BI knowledge and a PMI or CII qualification would be useful.

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience

  
**Additional Information**

At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.

If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks **with dated systems and painful processes.**

Lendable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident.

* Run blameless post-incident reviews, track actions to closure, and feed lessons back into detection, playbooks and controls.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Flexible Capacity Planning, MEATR DSP Strategy, Planning and Expansion
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Last mile demand changes by the hour, the day and the season, and our delivery capacity needs to flex with it. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to design how our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) network flexes to meet demand, from 15-minute Quick Commerce to Core delivery.  
  
As Program Manager, Flexible Capacity, you will own flexible capacity models from first idea to launch and scale: part-time and flexible delivery associate models, shift design and rostering. You will start in our fastest services and take what works into Core delivery, adapting each model to the labour rules, partner base and market of each country. You will own the problem, the model, the economics, the compliance, the launch and the results.  
  
You don't need to be an expert in every area on day one. You do need to know how to take a programme from a blank page to measurable results, and how to build mechanisms that keep working after you move on.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the roadmap: define the problem, set the baseline and build the business case for flexible capacity models across fast delivery services and Core delivery.
* Design the model: work with DSP partners and station teams on shift patterns, rostering, part-time and flexible delivery associate models, and the incentives that make them work.
* Build the economics: model cost to serve, utilisation and DSP partner profitability with Finance, so cost comes down rather than moving elsewhere.
* Make it compliant: turn labour and transport rules in each country into model design, SOPs and partner guidance, working with Legal and People Experience.
* Pilot, then scale: run pilots with clear success metrics and guardrails, decide what to scale, change or stop, and adapt each model by country.
* Tech and mechanisms: write business requirements with Tech and Product teams for scheduling and capacity tools, and set up the reporting around them.
* Lead change: check operational readiness, manage risks and approvals, and build communication plans across stations and DSPs.
* Report and write: own programme metrics, contribute to business reviews and annual planning, and write clear, data-backed documents for senior leaders.

  
A day in the life  
You start by checking how capacity matched demand yesterday: where routes went unstaffed, where associates sat idle and what it cost. Mid-morning, you're with a DSP owner and a station manager testing a new shift pattern and what it means for their team and their margin. After lunch, you're with Finance on the business case for taking a part-time model into Core delivery, and with Legal checking it works under local labour rules. You finish by writing the update for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.  
  
About the team  
Amazon's last mile network in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey runs on Delivery Service Partners (DSPs): local businesses whose delivery associates bring orders to our customers. Our team sets the direction for DSP across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkey and South Africa: where we grow, how capacity is planned, how partners are paid and how the network is designed. We work where operations meets strategy, with station and dark store teams, DSP partners, Finance, Tech, Legal and senior leaders in the region and worldwide. We value clear writing, sound data and people who own their outcomes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Description de l'entreprise**

**Business Analyste Monétique (H/F) – 6 ans d’expérience**

**Alten, la maison des ingénieurs : qui sommes-nous ?**

Fort de plus de 35 ans d’expérience, le groupe Alten est présent dans plus de 30 pays. Avec ses 54 000 collaborateurs, dont 88 % d’ingénieurs, Alten s’impose aujourd’hui comme un acteur international de référence et un leader sur son marché.

Attaché au bien-être de ses collaborateurs, le groupe a été certifié **Top Employer** pour la 12ᵉ année consécutive. Cette reconnaissance repose sur un audit exigeant mené par le Top Employer Institute, évaluant plus de 600 pratiques RH, garantissant un environnement de travail de qualité pour tous.

**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**

Ce rôle est **stratégique** pour ce grand compte, qui cherche à moderniser ses infrastructures de paiement, à réduire les frais de transaction, à améliorer la sécurité des opérations et à se conformer aux **réglementations sectorielles** (ex : **DSP2, PSD2, PCI DSS, RGPD, ou les normes EMV**).
